parameters.content:
## 1 · Watch the snow  ❄️
Open-Meteo forecast every 6h across Thredbo · Perisher · Mt Buller · Mt Hotham — fires only when a mountain gets 10cm+ fresh, cold and under 40kts for 3 days

## 2 · Find flights + lodge  🔎
Apify scrapes cheapest flights out of Sydney to the winning mountain's airport + the best lodge on the hill (hard-capped spend)

## 3 · Pitch the crew  📣
Builds the proposal + sends it to the group with a Yes/No poll

## 4 · Book flights + confirm  ✈️
Emails the flight options, then polls the inbox hourly until the airline confirmation lands

## 5 · Land → transfer → après  🍺
Tracks the flight; near landing the AI voice agent books the snow transfer, then 1h later orders the après supplies to the lodge
